```{r}
labels <- c("af5", "hf5")
models <- c("", "cardiacfm")
suffixes <- c("0", "10", "20")

read_split <- function(split_num) {
  base <- paste0("/Users/fuminli/Desktop/ECG_MRI/csv_train_valid_test_individual_temp/split",
                 split_num, "/CHS/CHARGE_PREVENT")
  out <- list()
  
  for (lb in labels) {
    for (md in models) {
      for (suf in suffixes) {
        if (md == "") {
          fname <- paste0("test_", lb, ".csv")
          key <- paste0(lb, "_", suf)
        } else {
          fname <- paste0("test_", lb, "_", md, suf, ".csv")
          key <- paste0(lb, "_ECGstage1_RF_", suf)
        }
        fpath <- file.path(base, fname)
        if (file.exists(fpath)) {
          out[[key]] <- read.csv(fpath)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

tables_split1 <- read_split(1)
tables_split2 <- read_split(2)
tables_split3 <- read_split(3)
tables_split4 <- read_split(4)
```



```{r}
fill_CHS <- function(template, tables_split) {
  out <- template
  
  for (nm in names(tables_split)) {
    mask <- !is.na(template[[nm]])
    vals <- tables_split[[nm]]$y_pred
    out[[nm]][mask] <- vals
  }
  
  out
}

CHS1 <- fill_CHS(CHS_template, tables_split1)
CHS2 <- fill_CHS(CHS_template, tables_split2)
CHS3 <- fill_CHS(CHS_template, tables_split3)
CHS4 <- fill_CHS(CHS_template, tables_split4)
```

```{r}
add_qt <- function(df, cols) {
  out <- df
  for (nm in cols) {
    x <- df[[nm]]
    qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE)
    out[[paste0(nm, "_qt")]] <- dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
      x <= qs[1] ~ "low",
      x <= qs[2] ~ "intermediate",
      TRUE ~ "high"
    )
  }
  out
}
```

```{r}
CHS <- add_qt(CHS_HR, model_cols)
```

```{r}
AF_models <- c(
  "af3_0_pred_qt","af3_10_pred_qt","af3_20_pred_qt",
  "af3_ECGstage1_RF_0_pred_qt","af3_ECGstage1_RF_10_pred_qt","af3_ECGstage1_RF_20_pred_qt",
  "af5_0_pred_qt","af5_10_pred_qt","af5_20_pred_qt",
  "af5_ECGstage1_RF_0_pred_qt","af5_ECGstage1_RF_10_pred_qt","af5_ECGstage1_RF_20_pred_qt"
)

HF_models <- c(
  "hf3_0_pred_qt","hf3_10_pred_qt","hf3_20_pred_qt",
  "hf3_ECGstage1_RF_0_pred_qt","hf3_ECGstage1_RF_10_pred_qt","hf3_ECGstage1_RF_20_pred_qt",
  "hf5_0_pred_qt","hf5_10_pred_qt","hf5_20_pred_qt",
  "hf5_ECGstage1_RF_0_pred_qt","hf5_ECGstage1_RF_10_pred_qt","hf5_ECGstage1_RF_20_pred_qt"
)

AF_outcomes <- c("af")
HF_outcomes <- c("hf","hfpef","hfref")

fit_one <- function(df, model_col, outcome_base) {
  time_var <- paste0("tto", outcome_base)
  event_var <- paste0("inc", outcome_base)
  prev_var  <- paste0("prev", outcome_base)
  
  dat <- df %>% 
    filter(.data[[prev_var]] == 0,
           !is.na(.data[[time_var]]),
           !is.na(.data[[event_var]]),
           !is.na(.data[[model_col]]))
  
  dat[[model_col]] <- factor(dat[[model_col]], 
                             levels = c("low","intermediate","high"))
  
  f <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, "==1) ~ ", model_col))
  fit <- coxph(f, data = dat)
  s <- summary(fit)
  
  tibble(
    model   = model_col,
    outcome = outcome_base,
    level   = c("intermediate","high"),
    logHR   = s$coefficients[, "coef"],
    HR      = s$coefficients[, "exp(coef)"],
    SE      = s$coefficients[, "se(coef)"]
  )
}

run_for_dataset <- function(df, split_name) {
  af_res <- do.call(rbind,
                    lapply(AF_models, function(m)
                      do.call(rbind,
                              lapply(AF_outcomes, function(o)
                                fit_one(df, m, o)))))
  
  hf_res <- do.call(rbind,
                    lapply(HF_models, function(m)
                      do.call(rbind,
                              lapply(HF_outcomes, function(o)
                                fit_one(df, m, o)))))
  
  res <- bind_rows(af_res, hf_res) %>% 
    mutate(split = split_name) %>%
    mutate(
      HR    = exp(logHR),
      lower = exp(logHR - 1.96 * SE),
      upper = exp(logHR + 1.96 * SE)
    )
  
  return(res)
}

res_CHS <- run_for_dataset(CHS, "CHS")
```

```{r}
labels <- c("lavmax", "lavmin", "laef", "lvedv", "lvesv", "lvef", "lvm")

make_cmr_features <- function(split_id, df_list) {
  preds <- lapply(labels, function(lab) {
    name <- paste0("split", split_id, "_", lab)
    df <- df_list[[name]]
    df[["y_pred"]]
  })
  df_out <- as.data.frame(preds)
  colnames(df_out) <- paste0(labels, "_pred")
  df_out
}

cmr_features1 <- make_cmr_features(1, df_list)
cmr_features2 <- make_cmr_features(2, df_list)
cmr_features3 <- make_cmr_features(3, df_list)
cmr_features4 <- make_cmr_features(4, df_list)

```

```{r}
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

label_vars <- c("lavmax_pred","lavmin_pred","laef_pred",
                "lvedv_pred","lvesv_pred","lvef_pred","lvm_pred")

rf_vars <- c("age","chol","hdl","sbp","bmiimp",
             "egfr","dm","cursmk","lipid","htnmed","gender")

chs_list <- list(
  CHS1_new = CHS1_new,
  CHS2_new = CHS2_new,
  CHS3_new = CHS3_new,
  CHS4_new = CHS4_new
)

outcome_labels <- list(
  af    = list(time="ttoaf",    event="incaf"),
  hf    = list(time="ttohf",    event="inchf"),
  hfref = list(time="ttohfref", event="inchfref"),
  hfpef = list(time="ttohfpef", event="inchfpef")
)

hr_list <- list()

beta_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, 
                   nrow = length(chs_list), 
                   ncol = length(label_vars),
                   dimnames = list(names(chs_list), label_vars))
se_mat <- matrix(NA_real_,  
                   nrow = length(chs_list), 
                   ncol = length(label_vars),
                   dimnames = list(names(chs_list), label_vars))
  

for (outname in names(outcome_labels)) {
  
  time_var  <- outcome_labels[[outname]]$time
  event_var <- outcome_labels[[outname]]$event
  
  for (lab in label_vars) {
    for (sname in names(chs_list)) {
      prev_var <- paste0("prev", outname)
      df <- chs_list[[sname]]
      
      df_use <- df %>% 
        filter(.data[[prev_var]] == 0) %>%
        select(all_of(c(rf_vars, lab, time_var, event_var))) %>% 
        na.omit() %>% 
        mutate(label_z = as.numeric(scale(.data[[lab]])))
      
      fml <- as.formula(
        paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ",
               paste(c(rf_vars, "label_z"), collapse=" + "))
      )
      
      fit <- coxph(fml, data=df_use)
      beta_mat[sname, lab] <- coef(fit)["label_z"]
      se_mat[sname, lab] <- sqrt(vcov(fit)["label_z", "label_z"])
    }
  }
  # mean ± 1.96 SD
  beta_summary <- sapply(label_vars, function(lab) {
    betas <- beta_mat[, lab]
    ses <- se_mat[, lab]
    m <- length(betas)
  
    Q_bar <- mean(betas, na.rm = TRUE)
    U_bar <- mean(ses^2, na.rm = TRUE)
    B <- var(betas, na.rm = TRUE)
  
    T_total <- U_bar + (1 + 1/m) * B
    df_old <- (m - 1) * (1 + U_bar/((1 + 1/m) * B))^2
  
    se_total <- sqrt(T_total)
    lower <- Q_bar - qt(0.975, df_old) * se_total
    upper <- Q_bar + qt(0.975, df_old) * se_total
  
    c(mean = Q_bar, lower = lower, upper = upper, se_total = se_total, df = df_old)
  })
  
  hr_summary_df <- as.data.frame(t(beta_summary)) %>%
    mutate(
      label    = rownames(.),
      HR       = exp(mean),
      HR_lower = exp(lower),
      HR_upper = exp(upper)
    ) %>%
    select(label, HR, HR_lower, HR_upper)

  hr_list[[outname]] <- hr_summary_df
}

hr_list

```



```{r}
p <- ggplot(plotdata, aes(x = feature_base, y = HR)) +
  geom_point(color = "#2A9D8F", size = 1)  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = HR_lower, ymax = HR_upper),
                width = 0.1, color = "#2A9D8F") +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ ., scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2.5)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                               face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  ) 
```
